name: Four Seasons Resort Anguilla
positioning: Beachfront Four Seasons resort on Anguilla, between the beaches of Barnes and Meads Bay
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort with ocean-view rooms and pools
Families looking for a dedicated kids' facility

facts.text: The resort spans 35 acres between the beaches of Barnes and Meads Bay.
80 percent of the accommodations have ocean views.
The resort has three outdoor pools.
SALT is a blufftop restaurant with views of Barnes Bay and Meads Bay.
Lima-Limon is a Mexican restaurant set on Barnes Bay.
Bamboo Bar & Grill is a restaurant and bar along Meads Bay.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Ocean-View Room has a plunge pool on a private sundeck.
The Sunset Pool is an adults-only, infinity-edge pool that overlooks the bluff.
The resort has a dedicated, fully supervised Kids for All Seasons facility.
The Spa offers treatments in a spa cabana.

considerations.text: The most common way to reach Anguilla is to fly into Princess Juliana International Airport (SXM) and then take a sea shuttle.
A private boat charter is needed if transport to St Maarten must take place before 8:30 am or after 5:30 pm.
WhataHotel notes that ultra-luxury pricing reflects its premium positioning.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
